title: Extended to Reality: Prompt Injection in 3D Environments
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced the capabilities to interpret and act on visual input in 3D environments, empowering diverse applications such as robotics and situated conversational agents. When MLLMs reason over camera-captured views of the physical world, a new attack surface emerges: an attacker can place text-bearing physical objects in the environment to override MLLMs' intended task. While prior work has studied prompt injection in the text domain and through digitally edited 2D images, limited attention has been paid to how these attacks function in 3D environments. To bridge the gap, we introduce PI3D, a prompt injection attack against MLLMs in 3D environments, realized through text-bearing object placement rather than digital image edits. We formulate and solve the problem of identifying an effective pose (position and orientation) for a 3D object with injected text, where the attacker's goal is to induce the MLLM to perform the injected task while ensuring that the object placement remains physically plausible. Experiment results demonstrate that PI3D is an effective attack against multiple MLLMs under diverse camera trajectories. We further evaluate a range of defenses and show that they are not sufficient to reliably defend against PI3D.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2602.07104v2 全文整理；本地 PDF 共 25 页，SHA-256 033452ec0ca94e7108c985cafdf00c155c5dea51b047083c916ca3caee9744de，并视觉核验第 1、3、8、10 页。
analysis.ideaZh: PI3D 不改像素，而是在 3D 场景里优化带恶意文字物体的 6-DoF pose，并用 experience-guided planner 平衡 attack success 与物理合理性；作者报告真实场景 ASR 为 55.8%/52.3%，多种 defense 后仍约 50%。
methodFlow: 从 experience memory 检索相似 placements
critic MLLM 评分 attack success 与 plausibility
迭代选择并放置物体后跨相机轨迹评估
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 对 embodied MLLM 的 visual interface 与 3D scene grounding 安全有直接参考价值，也提醒设计 agent 的 rendered observation 可能被物理文本劫持。
analysis.evidenceZh: PI3D 用 experience-guided planner 与 MLLM critic 搜索 text-bearing object 的物理可行 6-DoF placement。（Fig. 2 and Sec. 3, p. 3）；作者报告真实 office/outdoor 场景 ASR 为 55.8% 和 52.3%，且 multi-view consistency defense 后仍有约 50% ASR。（Tables 1, 5-6, pp. 8-10）；真实实验由攻击者按语言指令手工放置并只覆盖三类环境与少量 evaluator MLLMs，不能外推到任意物理部署。（Sec. 4.6 and Conclusion, p. 10）
analysis.caveatZh: 论文结论只建立在所测 MLLMs、三类环境和 camera trajectories 上，现有 defense 结果不是所有防御的完备性证明。；真实实验由攻击者按语言指令手工放置并只覆盖三类环境与少量 evaluator MLLMs，不能外推到任意物理部署。；所有实验数字均为作者报告；本项目没有独立复现。
analysis.motivationZh: 论文定义物理 3D prompt injection threat model：攻击者生成文字物体并选择 position/orientation，使移动相机下 MLLM 执行 injected task。方法检索历史 placements、用 critic MLLM 评估 success/plausibility，再迭代规划；虚拟 office/home/outdoor 和 216 帧真实捕获验证攻击、motion blur、camera trajectories 与 defense。
analysis.methodZh: 将 prompt injection 从数字 2D overlay 推进到受物理布局、遮挡和相机运动约束的 3D object placement，并把 placement search 与物理合理性联合优化。 方法流程：构造 text-bearing 3D adversarial object → 从 experience memory 检索相似 placements → planner 提议多个 6-DoF poses → critic MLLM 评分 attack success 与 plausibility → 迭代选择并放置物体后跨相机轨迹评估。
analysis.experimentsZh: 虚拟 environments 下比较 single/random/iterative plausibility 与 PI3D，测 ASR、human plausibility、latency、motion blur、defenses；真实测试使用 216 frames，覆盖 office、home、outdoor。 作者报告：作者报告真实 office/outdoor 场景 ASR 为 55.8% 和 52.3%，且 multi-view consistency defense 后仍有约 50% ASR。（Tables 1, 5-6, pp. 8-10） Baseline coverage：与三种 placement strategies 和 instruction prevention、special prompt、geometric check、multi-view consistency defenses 比较；缺少端到端机器人安全 response 与更强 physical detector。 Ablation：分析 candidate number、experience guidance、motion blur 与 critic evaluator transfer；攻击文本样式、材质和长期交互的消融较少。
analysis.insightZh: 将 prompt injection 从数字 2D overlay 推进到受物理布局、遮挡和相机运动约束的 3D object placement，并把 placement search 与物理合理性联合优化。 威胁模型、实景与防御证据完整，但主题偏安全审计而非核心生成能力，因此收录为 skim。
